Having previously ordered the Multnomah County Circuit Court closed due to inclement weather
conditions on January 11, 2017 and January 12, 2017, having previously found good cause to extend the
time for preliminary hearings, and being aware that all grand jury proceedings were likewise canceled due
to weather, the court enters this blanket ORDER resetting dates.
All cases that were previously scheduled to have a preliminary hearing or arraignment on an indictment in
Justice Center Courtroom #3 on January 11, 2017, January 12, 2017, or January 13, 2017 are hereby set
for a preliminary hearing date of January 18, 2017, which will result in an arraignment on the resulting
indictment, if any, at 9:30 on January 19, 2017 in Justice Center Courtroom #3.
The court finds good cause based on the court closure and grand jury cancellations to extend the period
for the preliminary hearing in each case by the amount necessary to set the dates indicated above.
